Issue #86 browser proof of the Personalabteilung view on the real test stack (6 tests). An API-created HR person (Mitarbeiter role plus the Personalabteilung template, TENANT) opens the employee list, a detail page with exactly the tabs Stammdaten, Arbeitszeit, Urlaub, Salons, the reports, the month close and the salon admin without one answer >= 400 and without one request to /time-entries, /day-breaks, /retro-entry-requests or /overtime/month-saldo; changes a contract from the next month-first, adds and ends an Einsatzsalon, sets an exit date, finds the ended person with the filter Ausgeschieden, sees counts instead of dates for another person's month-close gaps, and creates an employee with a chosen Stammsalon in a two-salon tenant. Four matrix tests (390/360 px x light/dark) fulfil the list, salon-assignment, contract-history and month-close answers through page.route and check four pages each (16 cells) with the whole-page geometry probe plus a clipped-content probe; they found a real clipped Salons tab (fixed in the same plan). Needs only the tenant fixture plus API-created employees and salons; every date is computed from the current day, so no date dependency and no seed. Measured on the rebuilt test stack: 6/6 pass, whole e2e-ci selection 224 passed and 1 skipped (a pre-existing conditional skip in functional.spec.ts), 225 tests in 1.1 min. Issue #612: the reports step now expects the tab 'Zeiten & Konten' selected, switches to 'Urlaub & Abwesenheit' for the 'Urlaubsübersicht' and adds that the HR principal sees no 'Exportieren' button and no 'Heute' tab; the traffic check is unchanged and now also covers GET /reports/period (200, no time-data request). Issue #70 browser proof of several time entries on one day on the real test stack (2 tests, browser zone pinned to the tenant's Europe/Berlin). A tenant with two active salons: a worker records 08:00-12:00 in the first salon through 'Neuer Eintrag' with the Salon field, then 13:00-16:00 in the second salon through 'Weiteren Eintrag an diesem Tag' from the edit dialog of the first entry (start preset 12:00); the list shows both rows with the Salon column naming each salon; the calendar cell of the day carries the tooltip '2 Einträge' and switches to the list focused on the day (two highlighted rows); a third entry 11:00-14:00 overlapping the first is refused with HTTP 409 and the server's text 'Überschneidung mit bestehendem Eintrag', the dialog stays open and the list still holds the same three rows; the cell of a day with exactly one entry (recorded through the API) still opens that entry for editing with its salon preselected. A tenant with ONE salon sees no Salon field, no Salon column, no per-day add and no switcher, and 'Neuer Eintrag' on a day with an entry still opens that entry (D-12). Needs only the tenant fixture plus one API-created second salon and API-recorded entries; every date is computed from the current day (weekdays inside the 10-day retro window, in the tenant's zone), so no fixed date and no seed. Measured on the rebuilt test stack: 2/2 pass on the first run and on each of three further consecutive runs (4.1-6.0 s), whole e2e-ci selection 226 passed and 1 skipped (a pre-existing conditional skip in functional.spec.ts), 227 tests in 1.1 min.

Issue #92 browser proof of a trip between two salons on the real test stack (4 tests incl. the two Issue #660 cases, browser zone pinned to the tenant's Europe/Berlin). A tenant with two active salons and a day with 08:00-12:00 in the first and 12:30-16:00 in the second salon (recorded through the API): the day's cell carries the tooltip '2 Einträge' and switches to the list; 'Weiteren Eintrag an diesem Tag' opens the ordinary form (Salon field, break editor); the switch 'Fahrzeit zwischen Salons' replaces the Salon field by 'Von Salon' / 'Nach Salon', hides the break editor and shows the hint 'Der Weg von oder nach Hause ist keine Arbeitszeit.'; Von = first salon, Nach = second salon, 12:00-12:30 is saved with HTTP 201 and the list of the day then holds three rows, exactly one with the badge 'Fahrzeit' and the route '{first} → {second}'; a second trip 07:00-07:30 from the second to the first salon (before any entry of the day, i.e. a way from home) is refused with HTTP 409 and the server's German text 'Der Weg von zu Hause oder nach Hause ist keine Arbeitszeit.', the dialog stays open and the list still holds three rows. Issue #660 gap-to-trip action (2 tests, each on its own weekday and its own tenant): with the same two-salon day the day-check panel serves one button 'Fahrzeit 12:00–12:30 von {first} nach {second} erfassen' (the offer is READ from the real GET /day-breaks/checks answer, never mocked; its salon ids equal the two salons), one click sends POST /time-entries (HTTP 201), the checks reload, the button count is 0 (positive control: count 1 before the click) and the list holds three rows with exactly one badge 'Fahrzeit' and the route '{first} → {second}'; an offer made stale behind the page's back (the second-salon entry moved to 13:00 through the API, so the gap widens) is NOT posted: the page re-loads the day check first, the toast container contains 'Das Angebot ist nicht mehr aktuell', no POST /time-entries is sent, the reload shows the widened offer 12:00–13:00 (positive control) and the API lists no TRAVEL row for the day. A tenant with ONE salon is offered no switch, no offer button and sees no badge. Needs only the tenant fixture plus one API-created second salon and API-recorded entries; the day is computed from the current day (a weekday inside the 10-day retro window, in the tenant's zone), so no fixed date and no seed. Measured on the rebuilt test stack: 4/4 pass on the first complete run (5.2 s) and 8/8 on a repeat-each=2 run on a fresh stack (9.8 s), whole e2e-ci selection 290 passed and 1 skipped (a pre-existing conditional skip in functional.spec.ts) in 1.9 min.

Issue #835 browser proof of the leave planner on the real test stack (1 test, no browser-zone pin needed). A tenant fixture plus one API-created employee homed in the default salon and the VACATION entitlement of the plan year (GET /leave/entitlements/:id?year= creates the regular row): the admin (Admin template holds leave-plan:manage) opens /leave/planung?year=<next year>, opens the plan through the dialog 'Planung verwalten' of the page's primary action (POST /leave/plans 201; Issue #840), enters a wish for the employee through the wish dialog (manager path: person select, Von = second Monday of March, Bis = Wednesday; POST wishes 201), switches to the month view with the zoom radio of the toolbar and steps to March with the period switcher (Issue #840), drags the end handle of the wish bar two day columns to the right with real pointer events (page.mouse down/move/up; the PATCH is awaited and its answer must carry the Friday as end date), opens 'Planung verwalten' again, clicks 'Planung übernehmen' there and confirms 'Übernehmen' (POST takeover 200); the result dialog lists the person under 'Übernommen' and states the plan as 'Übernommen'. The API then holds exactly one APPROVED VACATION request of that employee on Monday to Friday and the plan reads TAKEN_OVER. Every selector is a data-testid of the page, timeline or dialogs, or the dialog and radio roles of the manage dialog and the toolbar (or a role name for the dialog buttons); no sleeps, every wait is on a response or an element. The plan year is next calendar year computed from the clock (so the year-scoped lists of #319 never hide the rows and no wish is in the past); March before the 20th has no public holiday in any Bundesland, so the priced days are the five weekdays. Needs only the tenant fixture; no seed. Measured on the rebuilt test stack (docker-compose.test.yml, rebuilt from this worktree): 1/1 pass on the first run (6.4 s), 2/2 on a repeat-each=2 run (4.7 s) and 1/1 on a third run (4.3 s). Re-pointed in plan 840-08 (planner on the one timeline, admin controls in the manage dialog): 1/1 pass on the rebuilt test stack, 2/2 on a repeat-each=2 run.

Issue #612 browser proof of the period report page (/reports) on the real test stack (42 tests incl. the six Issue #726 filter-bar width checks; measured on a fresh test stack: the six Issue #713 tests pass in 7.5 s when run alone; the #714 count was 6/6 in 14.2 s and the #612 count 24/24 in 21.7 s). Functional (5): two API-created people with closed entries in the previous and the current month (recorded through their own sessions, the retro window raised to its maximum); the left arrow and the preset 'Letzte 3 Monate' issue exactly one GET /reports/period each, the URL gains from/to, and the KPI 'Ist' and the person's table cell equal the figures READ from the intercepted response; another tab plus a reload keeps period, tab and table; two salons - a shared link with salonId selects that salon in the header, a header change adds it to URL and request, a reload keeps it; a name click opens the drill-down with person=, Back closes it, a modifier click opens a new tab with the drill-down open; the Exportieren dialog of a three-month period defaults its month select to the last month. Matrix (4): route interception of /reports/period (one real answer spread into 30 synthetic people, a long name, an exited person, big figures, at-risk vacation rows) at 390 and 360 px x light/dark on the Zeiten tab, the Urlaub tab and the drill-down - whole-page geometry, a clipped-content probe, and axe nested-interactive on the two mobile lists with a positive control; the matrix found two real defects (a saldo tooltip panel and the footer buttons of the wide modal clipped by the modal at phone widths, fixed in the same plan). Layout checks (15): month picker not clipped (elementFromPoint at centre and four corners) in editorial/modern x light/dark at 1280 and 390 px, no KPI value wider than its tile at 961/1280/1440 px (with an oversize control), sticky table header right below the period bar in editorial/modern x comfortable/compact. Issue #714 salon switch (6): a tenant with two salons, one person homed in each, both with a closed entry of the previous month in the second salon (recorded through the API, never mocked); the header is on the second salon (shared link) and, at 1280, 390 and 360 px x light/dark, the KPI tile 'Im Salon gearbeitet' (value equal to kpis.salonWorkedMinutes), the Stammsalon hint, the row of the person homed there, the section heading, the sub-heading 'Aushilfen aus anderen Salons' and the helper's name are each scrolled into view, in the viewport and not covered at their centre, with no overflowing element; two controls prove the check can fail (an off-screen probe is not in the viewport; under 'Alle Salons' the tile and the section do not exist). Issue #713 absences per person (6): a person created through the API with an approved own-illness request of two calendar days (a Monday and Tuesday of the previous month) and an approved child-sickness request of one day (the Thursday), the answer READ, never mocked (SICK 2, SICK_CHILD 1, sickDays 3); at 1280, 390 and 360 px x light/dark the card 'Abwesenheiten je Person', the person's Krank and Kinderkrank values (header and cells at 1280, list line at 390/360), the two sick lines of 'Abwesenheiten nach Art', the drill-down heading 'Abwesenheiten' with 'Kinderkrank: 1 Kalendertag' and the export option 'Abwesenheiten-CSV herunterladen' are each scrolled into view, in the viewport and not covered at their centre, with no overflowing element on the tab, the drill-down and the export dialog; two controls prove the check can fail (an off-screen probe is not in the viewport; a kind nobody has - Elternzeit - has no column or list entry and is only named in the hint, while the Kinderkrank column exists). The matrix answers now carry a consistent absence object per row and the Urlaub cell asserts 25 list items of the new card. Needs only the tenant fixture, no seed; the functional dates come from the current day (tenant zone), the matrix and layout checks install the browser clock on 2026-09-16 (longest month label).

Issue #840 browser proof of the Abwesenheiten areas on the real test stack (plan 840-02 slice 1, completed by plan 840-13, extended by the gap round 840-15 ... 840-18) - 11 tests (0-9 and 5b), all run, none is a fixme any more, no browser-zone pin needed. 0: the Uebersicht draws an approved request solid and a pending one dashed, read from the computed border-top-style. 1 (manager path, AC-2/AC-9/AC-13): Uebersicht (PENDING bar data-bar-style=beantragt, dashed), Antraege tab (the PENDING row shows the badge Offen and a dashed type chip), the action Im Posteingang pruefen lands on /inbox with the leave-approval-modal open, Planung -> Planung verwalten -> plan eroeffnen -> a wish for the employee through the wish dialog -> Uebernehmen, the result lists the person and the plan reads Uebernommen. 2 (employee path, AC-3/AC-13): a person created with a direct password signs in through the UI; a colleague's APPROVED SICK leave reads only as a bar with data-bar-style=abwesend and aria-label abwesend in /leave?tab=team, no text and no title/aria-label names the type (the KPI strip word Krankheitstage is the one allowed hit), the Kalender tab holds neither the colleague's name nor the type, Planung takes an own wish through the dialog (drag handles on the own bar only; the colleague's wish opens read-only with no save button, no Planung verwalten). 3 (markings at 1440x900, AC-8): a manual holiday on a Tuesday between the 8th and 14th of the current month and Monday closed in the salon's opening hours (both through the API); /team/leave Jahr zoom: scrollWidth <= clientWidth of the timeline scroller, the week heads of ISO week 1 and of the week holding 28 December lie inside the viewport, a week cell click writes zoom=quartal&datum=<its Monday>; Quartal: weekend, holiday (title and aria-label carry the name, focusable), closed Monday and today carry their classes. 4 (redirects on the built app, AC-1, A5): /teamcal, /leave/planung (admin -> /team/leave tab=planung, employee -> /leave tab=planung), /team/leave?view=approvals (tab=antraege&status=PENDING) and /team/leave?section9=<uuid> (-> /inbox, the case id seen in the redirect URL). 5 (axe, AC-12): wcag2a/wcag2aa, every impact, on all tabs of /team/leave and /leave (Jahr and Monat zoom, a pending request, an open plan with a wish) and on the open Planung verwalten dialog. The colour-contrast rule is disabled app-wide for the first pass, like accessibility.spec.ts (shared design tokens - sidebar section labels, version label, eyebrow, KPI labels, badge colours - sit below 4.5:1 and predate the phase) and runs in a second pass restricted to the markup of this phase (toolbar, timeline, legend), which is clean. 5b: the same scan on /inbox with an open request; it runs (the fixme of plan 840-13 ended in plan 840-14 when the shared ApprovalRow stopped nesting the Pruefen button in the row button). 6 (gap round, G-5/G-6/G-2): Planung at 1440x900 - the forecast column sits right of the day viewport, the last day of the quarter can be scrolled to the left of it, the weiter hint lies below the header, the planner controls are in the toolbar, the planner is one card, the weekend shade is at least 1.2:1 against the timeline background. 7 (gap round, G-1/G-3/G-8): the Antraege count is a neutral explained pill on a directly opened Planung tab and leads to the Offen filter, the type chips of the Antraege list and the inbox carry the colours of the one mapping (dashed for a requested row, filled for a set one), the inbox header reads Team / Inbox, axe incl. colour contrast on Planung with the count. 8 (gap round, G-9): Neue Abwesenheit at 1440x900 - Mitarbeiter and Art share a top and are each at least 200 px wide, Von and Bis share a top below them, no eyebrow; at 420 px every field stacks; the own form puts Von and Bis side by side. 9 (gap round, G-7): the primary buttons of the leave pages (Neue Abwesenheit in both areas, Planung verwalten, Wunsch hinzufuegen) compute exactly the colours of the reference primary on /admin/employees and reach 4.5:1 against every background stop, for editorial and modern skin x pflaume, nacht, wald x light and dark x rest and hover (24 combinations per button; the look is set on html in the page, nothing persisted, transitions off). Fixtures: the per-test tenant, synthetic employees with .test addresses created through the API, requests/plans/wishes/holiday/opening hours through the API with the tenant admin token. No date dependency: the Uebersicht month is next month, the planner year is next year (March Mondays), the marking day derives from the current month, the sick span from the first of the current month through at most today, all computed from the clock. No sleeps - every wait is a response, URL, element or settled animation. Measured on the rebuilt test stack (docker-compose.test.yml built from this worktree): the four specs leave-area-840, leave-flow, leave-plan and month-bar-narrow-viewport with --project=e2e-ci gave 78 passed in 44.7 s; test 9 alone passes in about 6 s, test 8 in about 4 s; against the primary recipe before the gap fix test 9 measured 60 of 120 values below 4.5:1 (every editorial hover, every modern light-mode value) and every leave button equal to the reference, which is how the cause was found.
